- But the last window has a lower prediction (0.31) and high p_critical (0.46)
- The interval widths are very wide, especially for the last window (1.01), indicating high uncertainty
- Only 1 out of 13 windows has p_critical > 0.5

The query shows strong early warning signals in the features (increasing variance, skewness, kurtosis), but the model predictions are mixed. The last window is concerning (prediction 0.31, p_critical 0.46), but the uncertainty is very high.
